stem: This backpack ____ too heavy for me to carry.
explain_zh: 主詞 This backpack 是第三人稱單數，be動詞現在式要用 is；are 用於複數主詞，am 只能搭配 I，be 是原形動詞不能單獨當述語。

stem: My uncle ____ his own bakery near our neighborhood.
explain_zh: 主詞 my uncle 是第三人稱單數，一般現在式動詞要加 s，owns 正確；own 少了 s，owning 缺助動詞，owned 是過去式。

stem: We ____ a great time at the beach last Saturday.
explain_zh: last Saturday 提示過去式，have 的過去式是 had；have/has 是現在式，having 缺助動詞。

stem: Be quiet! My grandfather ____ a nap in the next room.
explain_zh: 情境是此刻正在做的動作，要用 be + Ving，is taking 正確；take/takes 是簡單式，took 是過去式。

stem: My cousin ____ visit us in Tainan this coming holiday.
explain_zh: this coming holiday 表示未來，要用 will + 原形動詞；did 是過去式，is/does 不能直接接原形動詞表未來。

stem: This pencil case isn't yours; it belongs to ____.
explain_zh: belong to 後面要接受格，her 正確；she 是主格，hers 是所有格代名詞，she's 是 she is 的縮寫，都不合文法。

stem: There is ____ university near my grandmother's house.
explain_zh: university 雖然字母u開頭，但發音是子音 /j/ 開頭，要用 a；an 用於母音開頭發音的字，the 表特定，some 不能接單數可數名詞。

stem: My little brother has five ____ in his toy box.
explain_zh: five 後面要接複數名詞，toy 加 s 變 toys；toy 是單數，toyes 拼法錯誤，toy's 是所有格。

stem: The bookstore closes ____ nine o'clock on weekdays.
explain_zh: 表示明確時刻要用 at；in 用於較長時段，on 用於日期或星期，of 不表示時間。

stem: ____ does your sister go to cram school, Monday or Tuesday?
explain_zh: 詢問時間要用 When；Where 問地點，Who 問人，What 問事物，都不合句意。

stem: You ____ eat too much candy; it's bad for your teeth.
explain_zh: 表示委婉勸阻不要做要用 shouldn't；can/could 表示能力，must 是強制肯定，語意都不合此勸誡情境。

stem: There ____ a lot of noise coming from the classroom.
explain_zh: noise 是不可數名詞，視為單數，there be 現在式要用 is；are 用於複數，were 是過去式，be 是原形。

stem: This backpack is ____ than the one I had last year.
explain_zh: 比較兩者要用比較級 lighter；light 是原級，lightest 是最高級，more light 是錯誤形式（light 為單音節）。

stem: ____ open the window; it's freezing in here.
explain_zh: 祈使句的否定要用 Don't + 原形動詞；Do 是肯定形，Doesn't 是第三人稱否定不用於祈使句，Not 不能單獨用。

stem: My parents ____ proud of my grades this semester.
explain_zh: My parents 是複數主詞，be動詞現在式要用 are；is/am 用於單數，was 是過去式。

stem: The library ____ its doors at eight every morning.
explain_zh: 主詞 the library 是第三人稱單數，現在式動詞要加 s，opens 正確；open 漏 s，opening 缺助動詞，opened 是過去式。

stem: I ____ my umbrella on the bus this morning.
explain_zh: this morning 提示過去式，leave 的過去式是 left；leave/leaves 是現在式，leaving 缺助動詞。

stem: Listen! Someone ____ the piano in the music room.
explain_zh: Listen 提示動作正在進行，要用 be + Ving，is playing 正確；plays/play 是簡單式，played 是過去式。

stem: ____ your family go camping again next month?
explain_zh: next month 提示未來式問句，要用 Will；Did/Do 是過去/現在式助動詞，Are 需搭配現在分詞，不合句意。

stem: The coach gave ____ some useful tips before the game.
explain_zh: give 後面要接受格，us 正確；we 是主格，our 是所有格形容詞，ours 是所有格代名詞，都不合。

stem: My brother wants to be ____ engineer when he grows up.
explain_zh: engineer 是母音開頭發音，要用 an；a 用於子音開頭名詞，the 表特定對象，some 不能接單數職業名詞。

stem: The kindergarten looks after twenty ____ every day.
explain_zh: child 的複數是不規則變化 children，要直接用；childs/childrens 拼法錯誤，child's 是所有格。

stem: We always eat dinner together ____ Sunday evenings.
explain_zh: 表示星期幾要用 on，on Sunday evenings 正確；in 用於較長時段，at 用於明確時刻，of 不表示時間。

stem: ____ sisters do you have, one or two?
explain_zh: sisters 是可數複數名詞，詢問數量要用 How many；How much 用於不可數名詞，How long 問長度，How often 問頻率。

stem: Students ____ wear their uniforms to school every day.
explain_zh: 表示強制規定要用 must；mustn't 表示禁止，語意相反，could/might 語氣不夠肯定，不合規定情境。

stem: ____ there enough chairs for all the guests tonight?
explain_zh: chairs 是複數名詞，there be 疑問句要用 Are；Is 用於單數，Was 是過去式，Does 不是 be動詞。

stem: Of all the students, David runs ____ in our class.
explain_zh: of all 提示三者以上的最高級，要用 the fastest；fast 是原級，faster 是比較級，more fast 是錯誤形式。

stem: ____ we take a break and get some fresh air?
explain_zh: Shall we...? 是提議「我們要不要…」的固定句型；Do/Are/Will 不能這樣直接用於此種提議句型。

stem: ____ these your new sneakers? They look really cool.
explain_zh: these 是複數主詞，be動詞疑問句要用 Are；Is 用於單數，Was 是過去式，Be 是原形。

stem: My grandmother ____ delicious dumplings every Chinese New Year.
explain_zh: 主詞 my grandmother 是第三人稱單數，現在式動詞要加 s，makes 正確；make 漏 s，making 缺助動詞，made 是過去式。

stem: I always ____ my bed before I leave for school each morning.
explain_zh: make the bed 表示「鋪床」是固定片語；do/take/play 都不能與 bed 搭配表示這個意思。

stem: Our homeroom teacher will ____ our seats again next Monday.
explain_zh: change seats 表示「換座位」；borrow/lend/fix 語意都不合換座位這個情境。

stem: My father's sister is my ____, and she lives in Chiayi.
explain_zh: father's sister（父親的姊妹）稱為 aunt（姑姑）；niece 是姪女，cousin 是表堂兄弟姊妹，grandmother 是祖母，都不合。

stem: This mango is very ____; I can't stop eating it.
explain_zh: 芒果通常味道是 sweet（甜的），符合「一直想吃」的描述；sour 是酸的，salty 是鹹的，spicy 是辣的，都不合芒果常見味道。

stem: My birthday falls ____ the first day of August every year.
explain_zh: 表示特定日期要用 on；in 用於月份或年份，at 用於明確時刻，of 不表示時間。

stem: It was so ____ yesterday that we couldn't see the mountains clearly.
explain_zh: 看不清楚山通常是因為霧大，foggy 表示「多霧的」；sunny/windy/rainy 都不會造成看不清楚的效果。

stem: You can borrow tools and get advice at the hardware ____.
explain_zh: 賣工具的地方是 hardware store（五金行）；school/hospital/office 都不是賣工具的地方。

stem: My favorite hobby is ____ comic books on rainy afternoons.
explain_zh: read comic books 表示「看漫畫」符合休閒嗜好的描述；cook/swim/paint 都不能與 comic books 搭配成合理動作。

stem: I felt very ____ after running five laps around the track.
explain_zh: 跑完五圈通常感到 exhausted（精疲力盡的）；bored 是無聊的，curious 是好奇的，proud 是驕傲的，語意都不如 exhausted 合適。

stem: I twisted my ____ while playing basketball with my friends.
explain_zh: 打籃球時容易扭傷的部位是 ankle（腳踝）；ear/neck/chin 都不是打籃球常見受傷的部位。

stem: This backpack was on sale, so it only ____ six hundred dollars.
explain_zh: 表示物品「花費多少錢」的主詞是物品時要用 cost；spent 主詞通常是人，paid 用法需接 for，saved 是節省，語意都不合。

stem: This jacket doesn't fit me; do you have a bigger ____?
explain_zh: 衣服不合身要換不同的 size（尺寸）；price 是價格，color 是顏色，style 是款式，都不是不合身的直接原因。

stem: Could you please ____ off the lights before you leave the room?
explain_zh: turn off the lights 表示「關燈」是固定片語；put/take/give 都不能與 off the lights 搭配成這個意思。

stem: I forgot to ____ my homework, so I have to do it at school now.
explain_zh: 忘記帶作業要用 bring（帶來）；borrow 是借入，lend 是借出，lose 是遺失，語意都不合「忘記帶來」。

stem: My sister's son is my ____, and he is only three years old.
explain_zh: sister's son（姊妹的兒子）稱為 nephew（外甥）；niece 是姪女、外甥女，cousin 是表堂兄弟姊妹，uncle 是叔叔，都不合。

stem: Don't eat that fish; it smells ____ and might make you sick.
explain_zh: 聞起來不好且可能讓人生病，應該是 smells bad（聞起來很糟）；fresh/sweet/delicious 語意都與「可能讓人生病」矛盾。

stem: The English club meets ____ Wednesday afternoon every week.
explain_zh: 表示星期幾要用 on，on Wednesday afternoon 正確；in 用於較長時段，at 用於明確時刻，of 不表示時間。

stem: Wear sunscreen today; it is going to be extremely ____ outside.
explain_zh: 擦防曬乳通常是因為天氣 sunny（晴朗炎熱的）；rainy/cloudy/snowy 都不需要特別擦防曬乳。

stem: We watched an exciting basketball game at the sports ____ last night.
explain_zh: 看籃球比賽的場地是 stadium（體育場）；bakery 是麵包店，library 是圖書館，clinic 是診所，都不是比賽場地。

stem: Every Saturday morning, my brother enjoys ____ chess with our grandfather.
explain_zh: play chess 表示「下棋」；cook/wash/cut 都不能與 chess 搭配成合理的動作。

stem: Our class ____ a science documentary during last week's assembly.
explain_zh: last week's assembly 提示過去式，watch 的過去式是 watched；watch/watches 是現在式，watching 缺助動詞。

stem: Right now, several students ____ posters for the art contest.
explain_zh: right now 表示現在進行，要用 be + Ving，are designing 正確；design/designs 是簡單式，designed 是過去式。

stem: The principal ____ announce the winners this Friday afternoon.
explain_zh: this Friday afternoon 表示未來，要用 will + 原形動詞；did/was 是過去式，does 不能直接接原形動詞表未來。

stem: The teacher asked my partner and ____ to present first.
explain_zh: asked 後面接受詞要用受格，me 正確；I 是主格，my 是所有格，mine 是所有格代名詞，都不合。

stem: My aunt works as ____ honest and reliable accountant.
explain_zh: honest 開頭的 h 不發音，等於母音開頭，要用 an；a 用於子音開頭發音的字，the 表特定，some 不能接單數職業名詞。

stem: The farmer keeps several ____ on his small farm outside town.
explain_zh: sheep 是特殊複數，單複數同形，直接用 sheep；sheeps/sheepes 拼法錯誤，sheep's 是所有格。

stem: The English speech contest will be held ____ the school auditorium.
explain_zh: 表示在某個空間裡面要用 in，in the auditorium 正確；on 用於平面，at 用於明確一點，of 不表示位置。

stem: ____ long does it take to walk to the MRT station?
explain_zh: How long 詢問「花多久時間」；What/Why/Which 都不能與 long 搭配表示這個意思。

stem: You ____ bring your ID card, or you can't enter the exam room.
explain_zh: 表示必要且強制的規定要用 must；might 語氣不確定，shouldn't 表示不應該（語意相反），would 不表示義務。

stem: There ____ several interesting exhibits at the science museum.
explain_zh: exhibits 是複數名詞，there be 現在式要用 are；is 用於單數，was 是過去式，be 是原形。

stem: This puzzle is ____ than the one we solved last time.
explain_zh: difficult 是多音節形容詞，比較級要用 more difficult；difficult 是原級，the most difficult 是最高級，difficultest 是錯誤形式。

stem: Why don't we ____ a card for our sick classmate?
explain_zh: Why don't we...? 後面要接原形動詞，make 正確；making 是現在分詞，makes/made 是變化形，都不能接在此句型後面。

stem: Neither of the answers ____ correct, so try again.
explain_zh: neither of 當主詞視為單數，be動詞要用 is；are/were 用於複數，am 只能搭配 I。

stem: The night market near my house ____ every evening at five.
explain_zh: 主詞 the night market 是第三人稱單數，現在式動詞要加 s，opens 正確；open 漏 s，opened 是過去式，opening 缺助動詞。

stem: The scientist ____ an important discovery two years ago.
explain_zh: two years ago 提示過去式，make 的過去式是 made；make/makes 是現在式，making 缺助動詞。

stem: Hurry up! The bus ____ already, and we might miss it.
explain_zh: Hurry up 提示動作正在進行，要用 be + Ving，is leaving 正確；leaves/leave 是簡單式，left 是過去式。

stem: I promise I ____ finish the project before the deadline.
explain_zh: promise 後面常接未來的承諾，要用 will + 原形動詞；did/was 是過去式，am 不能直接接原形動詞表未來。

stem: This trophy isn't for the whole team; it's only for ____.
explain_zh: for 後面要接受格，him 正確；he 是主格，his 是所有格，he's 是 he is 的縮寫，都不合文法。

stem: My father hopes to buy ____ electric car next year.
explain_zh: electric 是母音開頭發音，要用 an；a 用於子音開頭名詞，the 表特定對象，some 不能接單數可數名詞。

stem: We saw two ____ playing near the old barn last evening.
explain_zh: mouse 的複數是不規則變化 mice，要直接用；mouses/mices 拼法錯誤，mouse's 是所有格。

stem: Please hand your report ____ Ms. Lin before noon tomorrow.
explain_zh: hand something to someone 表示「把東西交給某人」；for/with/of 都不能表達「交給」這個動作方向。

stem: ____ bus stop is closer, the one on Park Road or the one on Elm Street?
explain_zh: 在有限選項中做選擇要用 Which；Who 問人，What 問事物但不用於比較兩個選項，Where 問地點但不能直接接名詞當形容詞。

stem: We ____ recycle bottles and cans to help protect the environment.
explain_zh: 表示委婉建議要用 should；must 語氣過強偏向義務，shouldn't/mustn't 都表示不應該，語意相反。

stem: There ____ not enough time to finish the whole test yesterday.
explain_zh: yesterday 提示過去，time 是不可數名詞視為單數，there be 過去式要用 was；is/are 是現在式，were 用於複數。

stem: This is ____ novel I have ever read in my life.
explain_zh: I have ever read 提示最高級用法，interesting 是多音節形容詞要用 the most interesting；more interesting 是比較級，interestingest 是錯誤形式。

stem: ____ forget to charge your phone before the school trip.
explain_zh: 祈使句的否定要用 Don't + 原形動詞；Do/Does/Did 都不是祈使句否定的正確用法。

stem: Both of my parents ____ teachers at the same elementary school.
explain_zh: Both of my parents 是複數主詞，be動詞現在式要用 are；is/am 用於單數，was 是過去式。

stem: My grandfather ____ the newspaper every morning before breakfast.
explain_zh: 主詞 my grandfather 是第三人稱單數，現在式動詞要加 s，reads 正確；read 漏 s，reading 缺助動詞，has read 是現在完成式不合句意。

stem: The workers ____ the old bridge last year for safety reasons.
explain_zh: last year 提示過去式，動詞要用過去式 repaired；repair/repairs 是現在式，repairing 缺助動詞。

stem: At the moment, the workers ____ a new playground for our school.
explain_zh: At the moment 表示現在進行，要用 be + Ving，are building 正確；build/builds 是簡單式，built 是過去式。

stem: The whole team felt ____ after losing the championship game.
explain_zh: 輸掉冠軍賽通常感到 disappointed（失望的）；delighted 是高興的，relaxed 是放鬆的，confident 是有信心的，語意都與輸掉比賽矛盾。

stem: You should see a doctor if your ____ keeps hurting after every meal.
explain_zh: after every meal（每餐飯後）提示疼痛部位是 stomach（胃）；hair/nail/elbow 都與飯後疼痛的情境不合。

stem: I need to ____ some money before I can buy this jacket.
explain_zh: buy 前面需要先 save money（存錢）；spend 是花費，cost 主詞通常是物品，pay 需接 for，語意都不如 save 合適。

stem: This shirt looks nice, but the ____ is a bit too bright for me.
explain_zh: 「太亮」是在描述顏色，color 正確；price 是價格，size 是尺寸，brand 是品牌，都與「太亮」無關。

stem: I need to ____ the plants every morning before breakfast.
explain_zh: water the plants 表示「澆花」是固定片語；cook/wash/cut 都不能與 plants 搭配成這個意思。

stem: Our science teacher always ____ us to ask questions in class.
explain_zh: encourage someone to do 表示「鼓勵某人做…」；forbid 是禁止，refuse 是拒絕，warn 是警告，語意都不合「鼓勵發問」。

stem: My mother's parents live with us; they are my ____.
explain_zh: mother's parents（母親的父母）稱為 grandparents（祖父母、外祖父母）；parents 是自己的父母，cousins 是表堂兄弟姊妹，relatives 泛指親戚，都不精確。

stem: The soup needs more seasoning; it tastes a bit ____ right now.
explain_zh: 需要多加調味料表示味道 bland（清淡無味的）；spicy/sweet/salty 都是已經有明顯味道，不需再加調味料。

stem: The final exams usually take place ____ the end of June.
explain_zh: at the end of 是固定用法，表示「在...末尾」；on 用於日期或星期，in 用於較長時段，of 不表示這個時間點。

stem: The road was ____ after the heavy rain, so drivers went slowly.
explain_zh: 大雨過後路面容易 slippery（濕滑的），所以駕駛人開慢車；dry/dusty/bright 都與大雨後的路面狀況不合。

stem: You can check out books and study quietly at the ____.
explain_zh: 借書並安靜讀書的地方是 library（圖書館）；gym 是體育館，cafeteria 是餐廳，clinic 是診所，都不合。

stem: My cousin spends most weekends ____ birds in the countryside.
explain_zh: watch birds（賞鳥）是常見的休閒嗜好；cook/sell/catch birds 都不是常見或合適的興趣描述。

stem: She looked ____ when she found her lost wallet under the sofa.
explain_zh: 找到遺失的皮夾通常感到 relieved（鬆一口氣的）；jealous 是嫉妒的，embarrassed 是尷尬的，nervous 是緊張的，語意都不合找回失物的情境。

stem: The doctor told him to rest because he had a high ____.
explain_zh: 需要休息通常是因為 high fever（高燒）；appetite 是食慾，energy 是精力，pulse 是脈搏，都不是「需要休息」的典型原因描述。

stem: The concert tickets are quite ____, so we need to save up.
explain_zh: 需要存錢表示票價 expensive（昂貴的）；cheap 是便宜的，free 是免費的，light 是輕的，都與「需要存錢」矛盾。

stem: These shoes are out of ____; the store doesn't have my size.
explain_zh: out of stock 表示「缺貨」，符合「店家沒有我的尺寸」；style/fashion/order 都不能與 out of 搭配表示缺貨。

stem: My father usually ____ the newspaper while drinking his morning coffee.
explain_zh: read the newspaper 表示「看報紙」是常見的日常習慣；cook/wash/clean 都不能與 newspaper 搭配成合理動作。

stem: The librarian asked us to ____ our voices down in the reading room.
explain_zh: keep your voice down 表示「放低音量」是固定片語；turn/put/take 都不能與 voices down 搭配成這個意思。

stem: My brother's wife is my ____, and she works as a nurse.
explain_zh: brother's wife（兄弟的妻子）稱為 sister-in-law（嫂嫂、弟媳）；stepmother 是繼母，niece 是姪女，cousin 是表堂兄弟姊妹，都不合。

stem: This beef noodle soup is famous for its rich and ____ broth.
explain_zh: 「famous」且「rich」暗示湯頭味道濃郁，flavorful 表示「風味豐富的」；bland/empty/watery 都與「famous、rich」矛盾。
